listing.description:
ChefSpecials turns the pantry and kitchen into a practical cooking workspace. Recipe generation begins with the food you already have, the equipment available, dietary requirements, serving count and cooking time instead of treating every request as an isolated chat prompt.

Users can maintain pantry inventory, describe their kitchen equipment, scan food from images, generate one focused recipe or several ideas, save favourites and recipes, and build ingredient baskets. Pantry policy can be strict when reducing waste or flexible when a better meal needs a few extra ingredients.

Ask Chef provides recipe-aware help for substitutions, timings, technique, food-safety questions and structured recipe changes. When packaged with cApp, recipe generation can run through capability-scoped on-device Local AI, with live drafts and validation remaining part of the product flow. Optional web research is bounded through the cApp MCP Context capability rather than giving the local model unrestricted browsing authority.

ChefSpecials is also the reference consumer integration for cApp: the same hosted product remains independently useful while cApp layers in local-first data, native packaging, Local AI, Guide and MCP capabilities through explicit SDK contracts instead of platform-specific product forks.

The public Showcase uses synthetic demo data rather than customer data, providing a realistic product walkthrough while keeping live authentication, billing and private mutation authority outside the demo.
features: Kitchen equipment constraints shape recipes around what you can actually cook with

listing.summary: ChefSpecials is a cooking workspace that generates and refines recipes around a real household: pantry inventory, kitchen equipment, dietary needs, serving count and time. It runs as a standalone web product and as the cApp reference integration, adding local-first data, Local AI and bounded Ask Chef research when packaged.
